Notes

任我行

In the preceding 行我看行, 行 xíng means “fine” or “that works.” In 任我行 it becomes going or roaming at will. Repeating the character carries the verse from verbal approval into freedom of movement. 神州 is a literary name for China.

  • Genius community transcript
  • Ministry of Education dictionary: 神州
洲际导弹

导弹, “missile,” and the following 捣蛋, “make trouble,” are both dǎodàn in Mandarin. The speaker upgrades himself into a long-range weapon, then uses the identical sound to tell younger people to stop acting up. The scale jumps from military threat to scolding a nuisance.

  • Genius community transcript
面子

面子 is social face, reputation, or outward standing. The next line says 底线, a personal bottom line, is abandoned to maintain it.

  • Genius community transcript
蛇鼠一窝

“Snakes and rats in one nest” describes disreputable people colluding together. It sits opposite the speaker’s repeated image of being a wolf alone.

  • Genius community transcript
口罩

The first mask belongs to the boast about being a missile. When it returns, other people have become a spreading virus, so it functions as a barrier against contact. Read together, the images make isolation both a display of force and a means of self-protection.

  • Genius community transcript
我勒个乖乖

我勒个乖乖 is an emphatic expression of surprise or disbelief. It is not a literal statement about a well-behaved person; “good grief” carries its function here.

  • Genius community transcript
扛

扛 literally means to shoulder or carry a load. After 出了祸, if trouble or disaster happens, it means bearing responsibility and consequences oneself.

  • Genius community transcript
